html_source: What Molly thinks I.N.R.I means. Bloom appears to believe her. I.N.R.I. are Latin initials for “Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews.” That is the title that the Roman procurator Pontius Pilate mockingly bestowed to Jesus and according to John 19:19, it was written on a sign and nailed to the cross above his head. Bloom tells us more here.
